Now let's test URI canonicalization and address parsing comprehensively. I'll test through the target URI (start line, stage 2) and the From header, checking the canonical target in output.

Actually, a more direct way: import main.py as a module and unit-test canon_uri / parse_address. That's faster and more precise. But the graders only test through the CLI; still, unit tests help me validate my implementation against the spec.

Let me write a unit test file that imports main.py directly.

arguments.command:
cd /app/dev && cat > t_uri.py << 'PYEOF'
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/app/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

fails = 0
def cu(s, expect):
    got, tel = m.canon_uri(s)
    if got != expect:
        global fails
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL canon_uri(%r) expected %r got %r' % (s, expect, got))

# --- SIP valid
cu('sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test')
cu('SIP:alice@LAB.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test')
cu('Sips:Alice@LAB.Test', 'sips:Alice@lab.test')
cu('sip:%61lice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test')
cu('sip:%41%42@lab.test', 'sip:AB@lab.test')
cu('sip:a-b_c.d!e~f*g\'h(i)j@lab.test', "sip:a-b_c.d!e~f*g'h(i)j@lab.test")
cu('sip:alice@lab.test:5060', 'sip:alice@lab.test:5060')
cu('sip:alice@lab.test:05060', 'sip:alice@lab.test:5060')
cu('sip:alice@lab.test:65535', 'sip:alice@lab.test:65535')
cu('sip:alice@lab.test:1', 'sip:alice@lab.test:1')
cu('sip:a@b.co', 'sip:a@b.co')
cu('sip:' + 'a' * 64 + '@lab.test', 'sip:' + 'a' * 64 + '@lab.test')
cu('sip:1@9lab.test', 'sip:1@9lab.test')
cu('sip:a@xn--bcher-kva.test', 'sip:a@xn--bcher-kva.test')
cu('sip:a@1.2.a.test', 'sip:a@1.2.a.test')
# --- SIP invalid
for bad in ['sip:@lab.test', 'sip:alice@localhost', 'sip:alice@lab.test:', 'sip:alice@lab.test:0',
            'sip:alice@lab.test:65536', 'sip:alice@lab.test:123456', 'sip:alice@lab.test:50a0',
            'sip:alice@-lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab-.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test.', 'sip:alice@.lab.test',
            'sip:alice@lab..test', 'sip:alice@lab.1est', 'sip:alice@lab_test', 'sip:alice@lab.test:5060;',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;transport=tcp', 'sip:alice@lab.test?h=1', 'sip:alice:pw@lab.test',
            'sip:alice bob@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test:5060 ', 'sip:alice@[1.2.3.4]', 'sip:alice@1.2.3.4',
            'sip:%61lice%@lab.test', 'sip:%zz@lab.test', 'sip:%4@lab.test', 'sip:%@lab.test', 'sip:%40@lab.test',
            'sip:%3b@lab.test', 'sip:%2541@lab.test', 'sip:%C3%A9@lab.test', 'sip:' + 'a' * 65 + '@lab.test',
            'sip:a@' + 'x' * 64 + '.test', 'sip:a@lab.' + 'x' * 64, 'sip:a@' + 'l' * 250 + '.test',
            'sips:', 'sip:', 'sip', 'http:alice@lab.test', 'tel:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@', 'sip:alice',
            'sip:alice@@lab.test', 'SIPX:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test#frag', 'sip:alice@LAB.TEST:5060x',
            'sip:+1202@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test:5060:1', '', 'sip:a@b.c:d@e.f']:
    cu(bad, None)
# host exactly 253 chars ok
lab = 'a' * 63
h = lab + '.' + lab + '.' + lab + '.' + lab            # 63*4+3 = 255 -> too long
cu('sip:x@' + h, None)
h2 = lab + '.' + lab + '.' + lab + '.' + 'b' * 61      # 253 exactly
cu('sip:x@' + h2, 'sip:x@' + h2.lower())

# --- tel
cu('tel:+12025550100', 'tel:+12025550100')
cu('TEL:+12025550100', 'tel:+12025550100')
cu('tel:+1-202-555-0100', 'tel:+12025550100')
cu('tel:+1.202.555.0100', 'tel:+12025550100')
cu('tel:+1(202)555-0100', 'tel:+12025550100')
cu('tel:+123', 'tel:+123')
cu('tel:+' + '1' * 15, 'tel:+' + '1' * 15)
for bad in ['tel:12025550100', 'tel:+02025550100', 'tel:+12', 'tel:+' + '1' * 16, 'tel:+', 'tel:',
            'tel:+123;ext=4', 'tel:+123?', 'tel:+1 2 3', 'tel:+12a3', 'tel:++123', 'tel:+12%33',
            'telx:+123', 'TEL', 'tel:+123@x', 'tel: +123']:
    cu(bad, None)

# --- addresses
def addr(v, expect_uri=None, expect_tel=None, fail=False):
    global fails
    try:
        uri, is_tel, j = m.parse_address(v, 0, len(v))
        if j != len(v) or (expect_uri is not None and uri != expect_uri) or (expect_tel is not None and is_tel != expect_tel):
            fails += 1; print('FAIL addr(%r) -> %r %r j=%d (want %r)' % (v, uri, is_tel, j, expect_uri))
    except m.Reject:
        if not fail:
            fails += 1; print('FAIL addr(%r) rejected unexpectedly' % v)

addr('sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('<sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('  <sip:alice@lab.test>  ', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"Alice" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('Alice <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('Alice QA <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('Alice   <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"Alice, QA" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"<sip:x@y.test>" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"a\\\\b" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"\\"q" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"a\\tb" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"" <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('"  " <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'sip:alice@lab.test', False)
addr('<tel:+12025550100>', 'tel:+12025550100', True)
addr('tel:+12025550100', 'tel:+12025550100', True)
addr('Bob <tel:+12025550100>', 'tel:+12025550100', True)
for bad in ['', '   ', '<sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test>', '<sip:alice@ lab.test>',
            '<sip:alice@lab.test> <sip:x@y.test>', '"Alice <sip:alice@lab.test>', '"Alice" sip:alice@lab.test',
            '"Alice"x <sip:alice@lab.test>', '<>', '< <sip:a@b.test>>', 'Alice;Bob <sip:a@b.test>',
            'sip:alice@lab.test extra', '"a\\" <sip:a@b.test>', '<sip:a@b.test>junk', 'a"b" <sip:a@b.test>',
            '(comment) <sip:a@b.test>', '<sip:a@b.test>,', '"Alice" <sip:a@b.test><sip:c@d.test>',
            'sip:a@b.test<sip:c@d.test>', '@ <sip:a@b.test>', '<sip:a@b.test', '<sip:a@b.test>>']:
    addr(bad, fail=True)

# --- From parsing
def fr(v, expect=None):
    global fails
    try:
        got = m.parse_from(v)
        if got != expect:
            fails += 1; print('FAIL from(%r) -> %r want %r' % (v, got, expect))
    except m.Reject:
        if expect is not None:
            fails += 1; print('FAIL from(%r) rejected, want %r' % (v, expect))

fr('sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t', ('sip:alice@lab.test', 't'))
fr('sip:alice@lab.test ; tag = t', ('sip:alice@lab.test', 't'))
fr('"A" <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t', ('sip:alice@lab.test', 't'))
fr('<sip:alice@lab.test> ;TAG=t', ('sip:alice@lab.test', 't'))
fr('<sip:alice@lab.test>;TaG=' + 'z' * 32, ('sip:alice@lab.test', 'z' * 32))
fr('<tel:+12025550100>;tag=t', ('tel:+12025550100', 't'))
fr("<sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=a'b~c", ("sip:alice@lab.test", "a'b~c"))
for bad in ['sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test;', 'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=' + 'z' * 33, 'sip:alice@lab.test;foo=t',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t;tag=u', 'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t;x',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t ', '<sip:alice@lab.test>tag=t',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;ta g=t', 'sip:alice@lab.test;tag= t', '<sip:a@b.test>;tag=t>',
            'sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t;']:
    fr(bad, None)

# --- CSeq
def cs(v, meth, expect):
    global fails
    try:
        got = m.parse_cseq(v, meth)
    except m.Reject:
        got = None
    if got != expect:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL cseq(%r) -> %r want %r' % (v, got, expect))
cs('1 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', 1)
cs('0001 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', 1)
cs('1\tMESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', 1)
cs('1  \t MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', 1)
cs('2147483647 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', 2147483647)
cs('0 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('2147483648 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('00000000001 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('1MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('1 message', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('1 MESSAGE ', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('1 INVITE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs(' MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('-1 MESSAGE', 'MESSAGE', None)
cs('1 MESSAGE X', 'MESSAGE', None)

# --- privacy / identity lists
def pv(rows, expect):
    global fails
    try:
        got = m.parse_privacy(rows)
    except m.Reject:
        got = None
    if got != expect:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL privacy(%r) -> %r want %r' % (rows, got, expect))
pv(None, 'absent')
pv(['id'], 'id'); pv(['ID'], 'id'); pv(['none'], 'none'); pv(['NoNe'], 'none')
pv(['id;id'], 'id'); pv(['id', 'id'], 'id'); pv([' id ; id '], 'id')
pv(['id;none'], None); pv([''], None); pv(['id;'], None); pv([';id'], None)
pv(['header'], None); pv(['id', 'none'], None); pv(['ID;NONE'], None)

def pl(rows, expect):
    global fails
    try:
        got = m.parse_identity(rows)
    except m.Reject:
        got = None
    if got != expect:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL idlist(%r) -> %r want %r' % (rows, got, expect))
pl(None, None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>'], ['sip:a@b.test'])
pl(['sip:a@b.test'], ['sip:a@b.test'])
pl(['<tel:+12025550100>, <sip:a@b.test>'], ['sip:a@b.test', 'tel:+12025550100'])
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>', '<tel:+12025550100>'], ['sip:a@b.test', 'tel:+12025550100'])
pl(['"X, Y" <sip:a@b.test>, <tel:+123>'], ['sip:a@b.test', 'tel:+123'])
pl(['<sips:a@b.test>, <tel:+123>'], ['sips:a@b.test', 'tel:+123'])
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>, <sips:a@b.test>'], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>, <sip:a@b.test>'], None)
pl(['<tel:+123>, <tel:+124>'], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>, <sip:c@b.test>, <tel:+123>'], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>,'], None)
pl([',<sip:a@b.test>'], None)
pl([''], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test>;x=1'], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test> junk'], None)
pl(['<sip:a@b.test> <sip:c@d.test>'], None)
print('uri fails:', fails)
PYEOF
python3 t_uri.py
